## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (typecheck, lint, guideline check, unit tests)

- [ ] Switching display languages still never changes the file on disk
- [ ] User-facing strings added to both `src/i18n/en.ts` and `src/i18n/de.ts`
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under "Unreleased"
- [ ] No API keys, private notes or personal data in the diff
